inv.desc_en: Are you looking for a commercial space in the city of Barcelona? We present an excellent investment opportunity! This commercial space, ready to be fitted out, is strategically located, immersed in a consolidated residential area. This property is surrounded by residential buildings, various commercial premises, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, and green spaces that bring freshness to the environment. Furthermore, its proximity to bus stops makes it a strategic and accessible location. This property (2 combined units) is a true opportunity for those interested in business development, as it offers versatility that adapts to various types of businesses, or simply as a solid investment in a city in constant evolution and growth. Its versatility, strategic location, and development potential make it a highly attractive option to materialize your business or investment projects. This asset is currently rented, so interior photographs are not available. Would you like to receive more information? Do not hesitate to contact us. Visit without obligation. The property is currently rented, and I do not have direct contact with the tenant.
